description: This source file defines the Location class within the OpenMRS project, representing a physical location with attributes such as address components, hierarchical relationships, and associated tags. It includes methods for managing location hierarchy, tags, and address details, and is annotated for ORM mapping and auditing.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Represents a physical location within the OpenMRS system, including address details, hierarchical relations, tags, and type. Implements interfaces for address and attribute handling, supporting hierarchy management, tagging, and serialization.

methods.name: getLocationId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the location.

methods.name: setLocationId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the location.

methods.name: getCityVillage
methods.description: Retrieves the city or village name.

methods.name: setCityVillage
methods.description: Sets the city or village name.

methods.name: getChildLocations
methods.description: Retrieves child locations, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: setChildLocations
methods.description: Sets the collection of child locations.

methods.name: addChildLocation
methods.description: Adds a child location to this location, verifying hierarchy constraints.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns tags associated with this location.

methods.name: setTags
methods.description: Assigns a set of tags to this location.

methods.name: addTag
methods.description: Attaches a tag to this location.

methods.name: removeTag
methods.description: Removes a specific tag from this location.

methods.name: hasTag
methods.description: Checks if the location has a certain tag.

methods.name: hydrate
methods.description: Deserializes a location from its string ID.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the location's ID to string.

methods.name: getDisplayString
methods.description: Returns a display-friendly string for this location.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Retrieves the concept type of the location.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the concept type of the location.
